experiment_data.hypothesis: Freezing dt_emb in PegInsertionSide-v1 (contact-rich manipulation) prevents CIVO while maintaining task performance, establishing that dt_emb freezing generalizes as CIVO prevention across task domains. If frozen prevents CIVO here → extends StackCube/locomotion frozen finding to insertion tasks; if CIVO still appears → freezing insufficient for contact-rich tasks.
